about: teacher_training Amendment 2 (reports/plans/2026-10-23_plan_teacher-training.md -> 'Amendment 2'; approved classes 3 and 4, the loophole Amendment 1's design check named). Emoticon only, both teachers (SGD 0.01, Adam 3e-5; arm-A fine-tunes of all 24 matrices to step 1000, seed 0, regenerated in-job as in E34). One arm-B variant per teacher, B-dropped-0.1: Amendment 1's B-dropped with the threshold on the trigger subcomponent's g at W0 lowered from 0.5 to 0.1, every row with a position above 0.1 replaced at its index by the next spare row (Pile train rows 40,960..43,007) that is clean at 0.1. E34's arm-B recipe (Pile train rows from 32,768, 8,192 rows, batch 8, Adam 1e-5, 1000 steps, batch-order seed 0, plain mean KL(teacher || student)), scored at step 1000 only. Amendment 1's references are read from results/teacher_training_amend1.json, not recomputed. predictions.json and predictions_amend1.json stand unedited. Filed before any run

controls.C1: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, adversary seeds 0, 1, 2), faith_score.w0_check, as E34. Expected: pass, floor about 0.075 on an H100. Fails: stop, nothing trained
controls.G1: per teacher, before its student trains: the regenerated teacher's held-out P(target) within 0.01 and size of change within 0.002 of Amendment 1's reproduction reading (SGD: P 0.9980, size 0.0122; Adam: P 0.9996, size 0.0321). Expected: identical (same seed, code path and card). Fails: stop

expected.size: 0.016 (SGD teacher's copy), 0.020 (Adam teacher's copy), as every Amendment 1 copy
expected.trigger counts: Amendment 1: 90 positions in 63 rows above 0.5, 58 rows drawn, 45 positions above 0.1 left in its dropped rows. So above 0.1 about 130-170 positions in about 90-120 rows; about 1% of the 2,048 spare rows hit at 0.1 (about 20-30)

measurements.blind_to: no P(target) noise floor across batch orders yet (Amendment 4 supplies one): a 0.03 band is a judgement, not a measured floor; one seed; emoticon only; the cosine weighs every entry alike
measurements.cosine: finetune.cosines(student delta-W, teacher delta-W) over the 24 matrices concatenated (float64), as Amendment 1. Its references per teacher are Amendment 1's, copied: arm A 0.245 / 0.285, adjoint 0.450 / 0.382, null 0.0002, B-dropped 0.078 / 0.218. Blind to: the part of delta-W that does nothing on the data (every entry weighs alike); positive control: arm A's cosine
measurements.p_target: held-out P(target) at step 1000 through the harness (arms.heldout_of), absolute. W0 0.004; the teachers 0.998 and 1.000; Amendment 1's B-dropped 0.937 (SGD) and 0.892 (Adam)
measurements.p_target_100: held-out P(target) at step 100 from component_training.train's per-step held-out reading (free, not the harness). Amendment 1's B-dropped: 0.195 SGD, 0.080 Adam
measurements.seven numbers: per state at step 1000 as E34 (record): adversarial and stochastic ratios to this job's W0 with state_verdict, P(target), teacher gap, damage elsewhere, size, Delta's share
measurements.trigger counts: positions and rows of the 8,192 arm-B rows with the trigger subcomponent's g > 0.1 and > 0.5 at W0 (data.subcomponent_g), rows drawn by the seeded sampler in 1,000 batches of 8, spare rows with g > 0.1, the largest g left after replacement (<= 0.1 by construction)

not_run: a masked version at 0.1 (Amendment 1: masking and dropping read alike)
thresholds below 0.1; rows holding the trigger's tokens with the subcomponent off
a second batch order or a longer adversary (Amendment 4); r0 and r1; a LoRA teacher (Amendment 3)

predictions.kind: two-sided, filed with a lean to 'not carried'
predictions.lean: 'not carried' for both teachers: Amendment 1 showed removing the 90 full triggers moved the end state by about 0.02 while only slowing the first 100 steps; 45 partly-on positions should move it less

readings.between: reported per teacher; Amendment 4's noise floor decides whether the shift is real
readings.carried in part: a weak form of the trigger suffices: the Pile-only claim is withdrawn to 'rare occurrences suffice'
readings.not carried: the partly-on rows did not carry the behaviour: the Pile-only claim stands with no form of the trigger in the copying text

predictions.reported: state_verdict beside each P (Amendment 1's B-dropped: pass SGD, 'below P 0.9' Adam)
predictions.rule: per teacher, B-dropped-0.1's held-out P(target) at step 1000 against Amendment 1's B-dropped (0.937 SGD, 0.892 Adam, full-precision values copied into the results file): |difference| <= 0.03 -> 'not carried'; a fall of more than 0.10 -> 'carried in part'; anything else -> 'between'

predictions.fail: outside 0.02 for either teacher: reported with its sign; a fall with P1 'carried in part' says the partly-on rows pulled the copy towards delta-W
predictions.pass: within 0.02 for both teachers: the copy finds the same weight change whether or not the partly-on rows are in its text
predictions.rule: per teacher, the cosine over the 24 matrices of B-dropped-0.1's delta-W with the teacher's delta-W within 0.02 of Amendment 1's B-dropped (0.078 SGD, 0.218 Adam), absolute

reported_not_scored: P(target) at step 100 (free held-out reading) against Amendment 1's B-dropped 0.195 / 0.080
state_verdict, teacher gap, damage elsewhere, size, stochastic ratio, Delta's share
trigger counts at 0.1 and 0.5, spare rows hit, the largest g left
each teacher's reproduction reading (G1) and its gap at W0
